heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a **Full-Stack Developer** and **ML Researcher** in my final year at **United International University**, specialising in Data Science.

I love building **SaaS products** and small, opinionated **tools that make daily life easier** — the kind where you ship something over a weekend and it quietly solves a real annoyance. There's something deeply satisfying about compressing friction out of a workflow.

Beyond that, I genuinely enjoy the overlap between building things people use and training systems that learn. I dive deep into ML research, experiment with new models, and figure out how AI can actually solve real problems — not just in theory, but in practice.
quote: Same curiosity that got me through a national Math & Physics Olympiad — just pointed at neural networks now.
